title: Antigravity
summary: I owned product delivery for an on-chain game: designing the architecture, building the core systems and leading the engineers. We shipped it on PulseChain and Base.

title: Titus Intelligence
summary: I'm building a historical data layer for Polymarket, connecting raw events to markets and positions. The indexer includes recovery checkpoints and checks on how the data is interpreted.

title: pm-ws
summary: I'm building a Rust daemon that lets Python and TypeScript applications share order books from Prediction Markets, with redundant feed connections and signals when a book loses continuity. Limitless is the first supported venue.
stage: In development · MIT licensed, public release pending

title: Titus
summary: I created a trading framework for Prediction Markets that separates strategy logic from credentials and execution. It brings together market data, exact money arithmetic and the controls needed to operate a trading system.

title: Oracl
summary: I designed and built a protocol prototype for Prediction Markets, connecting market creation, binary pricing and creator fees. An interactive investor demo made the proposed product explorable through simulated trading.
stage: Investor demo delivered · undeployed contract prototype

title: Supermigrate / Launchbox
summary: I led contract engineering for token migration and launches, writing the Launchbox contracts and co-authoring the migration system. The work included pricing, fee accounting and the transition from a launch into liquidity.

title: Toucan
summary: I led engineering for Toucan's cross-chain carbon bridge, from messenger contracts to tests and deployment tooling. The design kept token transfers consistent while the underlying messaging transport changed.
stage: Bridge delivered · later deployed by the team

title: Bipzy
summary: I led smart-contract development for tiered presales, NFTs and staking. I also built the index that made staking state available to the application.

title: dSafe
summary: I designed a TypeScript SDK that moves Safe transaction coordination onto decentralized storage while preserving familiar API calls. Built for Daoism Systems through the Safe Grants Program, it gives developers another way to coordinate multisig transactions.

title: Impact Evaluator
summary: At Curve Labs, I built the off-chain infrastructure for turning DAO contribution data into reproducible reward allocations. The prototype used Bacalhau and Ceramic, supported by a Protocol Labs grant to Curve Labs.

title: Simplr Events
summary: I designed ticketing contracts for Chain Labs' own product, covering private resale, dispute escrow and ticket redemption at the venue. The work was supported by an Arbitrum grant.
